headline: Recovered a write-back the tree could not show, closed every open S357 item, and found by looking at the homepage that its hero was still publishing commit subjects to visitors.

items.title: Every client script a page loads can now be updated by the content lane
items.insight: Production served pre-S356 bytes for 19 still-loaded scripts. 17 are now shell assets (five via the ambient bundle, trust-depth inside the idle loader, hashed children-first); the other two were false alarms from a gate reading an unbundled loader source.
items.evidence: drift that matters 19 to 0 on the rebuilt tree; drift gate self-test 13/13 with an unserved-loader negative control

items.title: You asked, we shipped reads only founder-declared links
items.insight: A git subject passed all three S357 filters within a day because rebind is not bind. The surface now reads the reader changelog, and an entry answers a theme only when the founder names it at approval.
items.evidence: ship-receipts self-test 24/24 pinning the exact leaked line; draft publisher 9/9 with answers validation

items.title: The homepage hero stops publishing commit subjects
items.insight: Found in the rendered-pixel pass, not by any gate: the hero read Shipped run the lane-drift measurement, and the feed held Refined record the three board items worked. The ticker and the returning-visitor strip now name the newest founder-approved changelog entry.
items.evidence: narrative self-test 14/14; all 84 theme captures show The Desk: real art in the hero

items.title: /changelog/ stops querying a table that must not exist
items.insight: vault_feedback returned PGRST205 on every visit; feedback policy keeps raw feedback browser-local. The loop section also still claimed the founder-presence underline retired for privacy.
items.evidence: 0 local 4xx on the rendered page, light and dark

items.title: A cut-off closeout recovered from git, not from the tree
items.insight: S357's final closeout never touched the SIL and three commits followed it. Two stale blockers were re-probed and closed on evidence: Supabase healthy, production comments 200.
items.evidence: writeback-currency flagged 9 commits, oldest 18.2h; /v/desk-comments 200 on both origins

followUps: Founder: tag a changelog entry with answers: frontdoor when one genuinely answers it, so the You asked box lights up.
Re-source api/changelog-narrative.json from the reader changelog with a plan for notify-changelog-subscribers, which keys mail off its sha.
Measure two light-theme candidates seen at thumbnail scale: /membership/ See The Value and /games/ status-count labels.
Next full deploy clears 32 unreferenced residue scripts.
